scope.method: Read main content of every scoped index.html; screened repeated eligibility, medical, currency, solo, testing, and hour claims; verified consequential claims against current eCFR and FAA primary sources. A URL in a page was treated as a lead, not proof.

sources.title: eCFR Title 14 Part 61, Certification: Pilots, Flight Instructors, and Ground Instructors
eCFR Part 68, Requirements for Operating Certain Small Aircraft Without a Medical Certificate
FAA Airman Certification Standards and Practical Test Standards
FAA Advisory Circular AC 61-65K, Certification: Pilots and Flight and Ground Instructors

corrections.issue: Clarify conditional BasicMed eligibility for student solo.
corrections.change: Eligible student pilots can use BasicMed under61.89(d); prior medical and all other requirements still apply. A draft blanket prohibition was rejected during parent review and never published.

corrections.issue: Existing student-only exclusion was incorrect and altitude/airspeed bounds imprecise.
corrections.change: Removed student exclusion; corrected at-or-below18000ft and not-exceeding250kt wording.

limitations: This is a bounded regulatory audit, not an exhaustive fact check of every aviation statement, product recommendation, price, salary, or local-school claim.

Dynamic pages were retained only where the main text clearly qualified variability and directed readers to current employer, provider, BLS, or local sources; those statements are educational comparisons, not current market findings.
Verified means the identified consequential claim matched the cited source family; it does not mean the whole page or all FAA content was verified.
